title: Week 4 Assessment: Rates, Work, and Motion
description: End-of-week checkpoint for rate tables, work equations, and motion setup.

questions.question: A runner covers 15 km in 1.5 hours. What is the runner's average speed?
Two people work together at rates of $\frac{1}{8}$ job per hour and $\frac{1}{12}$ job per hour. What is their combined rate?
Two buses leave the same station in opposite directions at 40 kph and 50 kph. How far apart are they after 3 hours?
A machine completes one task in 10 minutes. What fraction of a task does it complete per minute?
A person drives 60 km at 30 kph and then 60 km at 60 kph. What is the average speed for the full trip?
In opposite-direction motion, the distances usually add.
One worker finishes a task in 5 hours and another in 20 hours. How long together?
Two cyclists start 84 km apart and ride toward each other at 14 kph and 10 kph. After how many hours do they meet?
A car travels 126 km in 2.8 hours. What is its average speed?
A pipe fills $\frac{1}{6}$ of a tank per hour and another fills $\frac{1}{3}$ of a tank per hour. What is their combined rate?
Two trains head toward each other at 35 kph and 45 kph from stations 240 km apart. After how many hours will they meet?
If a worker can finish a job in 4 hours, the worker's rate is 4 jobs per hour.
A boat travels 54 km downstream in 3 hours. What is its downstream speed in kph?
One printer finishes a job in 6 hours and another in 4 hours. How many hours will they take together?
